family: KEPT, AND THIS IS WHY IT STILL CARRIES A DECISION AND A CONSEQUENCE IN A BLOCK WHOSE WANT HAS BEEN SPENT: A WANT IS THE BEGINNING UNDER PRESSURE, AN ASK IS THE GOAL A READER CAN STATE, THE REFUSAL OR THE ASK IS THE RESISTANCE, THE DECISION IS THE CHANGE, THE COST OF IT IS THE COMPLETED BEAT, AND WHAT THE OTHER PERSON DOES WITH IT AFTER HE HAS GONE IS THE ENDING THAT OPENS SOMETHING. NONE OF THOSE SIX HAS BEEN SPENT BY THE CLOSING OF THE WANT, BECAUSE THE WANT WAS NEVER A LINE IN A BOOK. IT IS NOW BEING ASKED FOR, BY FOUR WOMEN, IN FOUR ROOMS, IN ONE BLOCK, AND WHAT HE DOES WITH EACH ASK IS THE BLOCK.

the_protagonist.pronouns: he/him/his. MEASURED OFF THE FILES OF 995 TO 1004 AT 442, WHICH IS A MEASUREMENT AND NOT A TARGET, AND RE-MEASURED ON THIS BLOCK AFTER PROSE.
the_protagonist.his_want_at_the_start_of_this_block: THE SAME SENTENCE AS LAST BLOCK AND A DIFFERENT THING. HE WANTS TO BE ENTERED AGAINST WORK, AND HE HAS LEARNED IN FOUR DAYS THAT THE WORK MUST HAVE BEEN ASKED FOR BY SOMEBODY ENTITLED TO ASK IN A ROOM WITH THE REST OF THEM IN IT, AND THAT THE ONLY PERSON HE HAS SPENT TO GET A PAGE IS A WOMAN WHO WAS NEVER ASKED FOR ANYTHING.
the_protagonist.the_six_weeks: ALL THREE WOMEN ON THIS FRONTAGE WHO WENT UP THE RIVER COME BACK DOWN IT INSIDE THIS BLOCK, AND NOT ON THE SAME MORNING: THE WOMAN AT NINE AT 1008, THE SISTER AT TEN AT 1011, THE MOTHER AT TWELVE AT 1014.

the_protagonist.what_is_not_spent: NO NAME IS INVENTED, NO OUTLINE-NAMED CHARACTER APPEARS, NO REUNION IS INVENTED, AND MERCER, ARDENT AND JULIE ARE MEASURED AT ZERO ACROSS THE TEN.

cards.1005: THE WEIGH AREA AT THE UNIT IS A SHALLOW PIT IN THE YARD WITH A DIAL ON A POST OVER IT AND A KERB OF BRICK LAID ON EDGE ROUND THE WHOLE OF IT IN LIME. RAIN OFF THE YARD ROOF STANDS IN IT ALL WINTER AND THE DIAL HAS READ A HUNDREDWEIGHT LIGHT SINCE BEFORE THE SUMMER. HE HAS WANTED AT THAT KERB FOR TWO YEARS AND HAS NOT, BECAUSE THE KERB COMES UP UNDER THE PIT AND THE PIT IS UNDER THE YARD THAT EVERYBODY IN THE UNIT WALKS ACROSS. HE HAS A CHISEL AND A LUMP BAR AND TWO HOURS ON AN AFTERNOON HE HAS STOLEN FOR IT. HE DECIDES, DOWN THERE WITH HIS HANDS IN COLD LIME DUST, THAT HE IS GOING TO ASK THE WOMAN AT NUMBER TWELVE FOR THE WALL BEHIND HER MOTHER’S RANGE, WHICH IS THE ONE PIECE OF WORK ON THIS FRONTAGE HE HAS NEVER DONE AND THE ONLY ONE WORTH A LINE IN A BOOK. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: HE CANNOT LIFT FOUR FEET OF KERB OUT IN AN AFTERNOON AND HE IS NOT GOING TO MAKE IT GOOD WITH NEW STONE, SO WHAT HE OPENS HE CANNOT CLOSE, AND THE YARD IS OPEN TO ANYBODY WHO WANTS TO WALK INTO IT. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: HE HAS TOLD NOBODY, AND THE FIRST THING HE HAS EVER BEGUN ON HIS OWN GROUND THAT HE CANNOT FINISH IS ON HIS OWN GROUND.
cards.1006: AT NUMBER TEN, IN THE HALL, WITH THE FRONT DOOR STANDING OPEN BEHIND HIM AND THE COATS STILL ON THEIR HOOKS FROM THE SUMMER AND A BULB OUT IN THE PASSAGE. THE WOMAN OF THE HOUSE IS ALONE AGAIN AND HER SISTER HAS BEEN SIX WEEKS UP THE RIVER. SHE ASKS HIM TO MAKE THE FRONT ROOM LETTABLE BY THE DAY HER SISTER IS DUE BACK - CUT THE SOFT CORNER OUT OF THE SILL, LET IN NEW, LINE THE REVEAL SQUARE, AND PUT A BOARD ACROSS THE OPENING SO IT CAN STAND SHUT - AND SHE GIVES HIM THE FIGURE BEFORE HE HAS SAID ONE WORD. WHAT STANDS AGAINST IT: SHE WILL NOT HAVE IT DONE FOR NOTHING, WHICH HE HAS WAITED TEN YEARS TO HEAR, AND THE FIGURE IS ONE SHE HAS HAD TO COME UP WITH BY HERSELF. DECISION: HE TELLS HER THE FIGURE SHE HAS OFFERED IS RIGHT, AND IT IS THE FIRST TIME HE HAS TAKEN A SUM OFF ANYBODY FOR WORK HE WAS ASKED TO DO. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: HE HAS PUT A DAY IN THAT HOUSE, AND IT IS THE DAY HER SISTER IS DUE, WHICH MEANS HE WILL BE STANDING IN A FRONT ROOM WHEN THE ONE WOMAN ON THAT FRONTAGE WHO COULD HAVE SAID NO WALKS IN. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: HIS SEASON HAS A JOB ON IT WITH MONEY AND A DAY ATTACHED TO IT, AND HE HAS HAD NEITHER IN TEN YEARS.
cards.1007: AT NUMBER TWELVE, IN THE SCULLERY, WITH THE RANGE OUT AND THE SLAB WET ON THE SIDE THE RANGE STANDS AGAINST AND A DAMP LINE ON THE WALL BEHIND IT. THE SISTER IS IN. THE MOTHER WENT UP THE RIVER BEFORE CHRISTMAS AND HAS NOT COME BACK. THE SIX-HOUSE PAGE IS ON THE TABLE BECAUSE HE GAVE IT TO HER IN A COAL SHED FOUR WEEKS AGO AND SHE HAS HAD IT EVER SINCE, AND SHE ASKS HIM TO PUT HER OWN NAME AT THE BOTTOM OF IT AND TAKE HIS OFF. WHAT STANDS AGAINST IT: HE POINTS OUT THAT A NAME IN ANOTHER PERSON’S HAND IS NOT A NAME AT ALL, AND THAT THE PAGE WAS GIVEN TO HIM FOR HIM, AND THAT HIS NAME ON IT IS THE ONLY PROOF HE HAS EVER HAD THAT HE EXISTS ON THIS FRONTAGE. DECISION: HE STRIKES HIS OWN NAME OFF IT AND PUTS HERS WHERE IT WAS, IN HER HAND AND NOT HIS. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: THE ONE THING HE GOT IN FOUR DAYS OF ASKING. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: THE PAGE IN THAT HOUSE HAS THE DAUGHTER ON IT AND NO MAN ANYWHERE ON IT, AND THE ASK HE CAME UP THE FRONTAGE WITH - THE WALL BEHIND THAT RANGE - IS NEVER MADE AT ALL, BECAUSE SHE ASKED FIRST.
cards.1008: AT NUMBER NINE, IN THE PANTRY OFF THE KITCHEN, WITH ITS SHELVES ABOUT TWO FOOT DEEP AND A DOOR YOU HAVE TO GET ROUND THE CORNER TO COME THROUGH. THE WOMAN WHO DOES HER SHOPPING WENT UP THE RIVER SIX WEEKS AGO AND IS HOME, AND SHE HAS BEEN TO THE LOCK-UP AND HAS STOOD IN FRONT OF THE BOOK WITH THE COLUMN EMPTY ON IT. SHE ASKS HIM TO ASK THE WOMAN WHO KEEPS IT TO TAKE HER OFF THE BOOK. WHAT STANDS AGAINST IT: HE SAYS HE DOES NOT KNOW HER WELL ENOUGH AND HAS NEVER ASKED HER FOR ONE THING, AND SHE SAYS THAT IS NOT THE REASON. DECISION: HE AGREES TO CARRY IT UP. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: HE WALKS INTO A YARD FOR THE FIRST TIME IN TEN YEARS WITH SOMEBODY ELSE’S WANT IN HIS MOUTH AND NOTHING OF HIS OWN. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: HE HAS BECOME THE WAY A WANT GETS FROM ONE HOUSE TO ANOTHER WITHOUT EITHER WOMAN HAVING TO WALK IT, WHICH IS THE ARRANGEMENT HE HAS BEEN INSIDE FOR TEN YEARS AND HAS NEVER ONCE BEEN ON THE WRONG SIDE OF.
cards.1009: AT THE LOCK-UP, IN THE SMALL STORE OFF THE YARD, WITH ONE HIGH WINDOW OF SMALL PANES, A SHELF PUT ACROSS THE MIDDLE OF IT, AND NOTHING ELSE IN THE ROOM AT ALL. HE PUTS THE WOMAN’S WANT TO THE WOMAN WHO KEEPS THE BOOK. SHE GIVES HIM THE PRICE IN THREE SENTENCES: A NAME COMES OFF A BOOK AT THE END OF A SEASON AND NOT BEFORE, THE SIX WEEKS THAT WOMAN DID UP THE RIVER GO ON IT, AND THE BOOK SHUTS ON FRIDAY. WHAT STANDS AGAINST IT: HE ASKS WHETHER A NAME CAN BE PUT ON OUTSIDE A SEASON AND IS TOLD THE BOOK HAS ONE RULED COLUMN AND NOT A SECOND. DECISION: HE DOES NOT ARGUE FURTHER, AND HE HEARD A PRICE AND DID NOT WORK ON IT. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: THE THING HE CARRIED UP HERE COSTS ITS REQUESTER HER OWN WORK, AND HE CANNOT TELL HER THAT WITHOUT TAKING OFF HER THE ONE THING SHE ASKED HIM FOR. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: HE UNDERSTANDS THAT THE BOOK IS A LIST OF WORK AND NOT A LIST OF PEOPLE, AND THAT A PERSON HAS ONLY EVER BEEN ON IT AS A WAY OF STANDING NEXT TO A JOB.
cards.1010: AT THE UNIT, IN THE COVERED WAY BETWEEN THE TWO BUILDINGS, WHICH IS ABOUT FIVE FEET WIDE FROM WALL TO WALL, WITH A ROW OF IRON HOOKS DOWN ONE SIDE AND A BENCH ALONG THE OTHER AND A GUTTER DOWN THE MIDDLE OF THE FLOOR. HE HAS COME IN OUT OF THE RAIN WITH NOWHERE IN PARTICULAR TO BE. HE WORKS OUT, STANDING THERE, WHAT THE WOMAN AT NINE’S ASK HAS DONE TO THE QUESTION HE HAS BEEN CARRYING SINCE THE COAL SHED: IF WHAT A WOMAN WILL ASK FOR IS A REMOVAL, THEN THE ONLY PERSON ON THIS FRONTAGE WHO CAN STILL BE ASKED FOR ANYTHING IS THE SISTER DUE BACK AT NUMBER TEN, WHO HAS BEEN AWAY SIX WEEKS AND HAS NEVER ONCE BEEN ASKED FOR A THING. DECISION: HE DECIDES HE WILL ASK HER. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: HE SAYS OUT LOUD IN AN EMPTY COVERED WAY THAT THIS IS THE SAME THING HE SAID IN A COAL SHED A MONTH BACK ABOUT A DIFFERENT WOMAN, WHICH HE HAS SAID ONCE AND CARRIED ON WITH EVER SINCE. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: HE HAS CHOSEN THE ARRANGEMENT OVER THE MAN AND HE HAS NOT PRETENDED TO HIMSELF THAT CHOOSING WAS HARD.
cards.1011: AT NUMBER TEN, IN THE SECOND BEDROOM, WHERE THE SISTER’S BED STILL STANDS AGAINST THE WALL WITH NOTHING ON THE MATTRESS, MADE UP BEFORE SHE WENT. HE HAS COME TO ASK. THE SISTER IS HOME, AND SHE HAS BEEN IN THE FRONT ROOM, AND SHE HAS SEEN WHAT THE WOMAN OF THE HOUSE DID TO THE WINDOW WITH A CHISEL AND A BLOCK OF WOOD. SHE ASKS HIM, BEFORE HE CAN ASK HER FOR ANYTHING, TO GO AND LOOK AT IT AND TELL HER WHETHER IT IS RIGHT. WHAT STANDS AGAINST IT: IF IT IS NOT RIGHT HE HAS TO SAY SO IN FRONT OF THE WOMAN WHO PAID FOR IT AND WHO HAD TO WORK AT PAYING HIM. DECISION: HE SAYS IT IS NOT RIGHT AND SAYS WHERE, AND SHE TELLS HIM TO PUT IT RIGHT. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: THE SUM HAS TO COME OUT OF THE SAME TIN, AND HE HAS TAKEN A MEND ON WORK THAT HAD HIS NAME IN A WOMAN’S MOUTH AND NOT ON ANY PIECE OF PAPER. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: THE FIRST PIECE OF WORK IN THREE BLOCKS THAT ANYBODY ASKED HIM FOR IS A REPAIR OF A REPAIR, AND NO PAGE ANYWHERE WILL CARRY IT.
cards.1012: AT NUMBER NINE, IN THE KITCHEN, WITH THE RANGE LIT AT LAST AFTER SIX WEEKS COLD AND THE DOOR OF IT STANDING IN ON ITS HINGE THE WAY IT DOES WHEN THERE IS A FIRE IN IT. THE WOMAN IS IN, AND SHE HAS BEEN BACK TO THE LOCK-UP SINCE HE WAS THERE, AND SHE HAS STOOD IN FRONT OF THE OPEN BOOK ON THE TABLE IN THE MIDDLE BAY AND HAS WORKED OUT THE PRICE FOR HERSELF. SHE ASKS HIM TO BE IN THE ROOM ON FRIDAY MORNING WHEN THE BOOK SHUTS, BECAUSE A NAME COMES OFF A BOOK AND SHE WANTS A PERSON IN THE ROOM WHILE IT HAPPENS. WHAT STANDS AGAINST IT: HE ASKS HER WHETHER A MAN STANDING IN A ROOM MAKES HER ENTERED OR ONLY PRESENT, AND SHE SAYS SHE HAS THOUGHT ABOUT IT AND DOES NOT CARE WHICH. DECISION: HE SAYS HE WILL BE THERE. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: HE HAS BEEN ASKED FOR SOMETHING THAT IS NOT WORK AND A FIGURE CANNOT BE PUT AGAINST IT AND NEITHER CAN A SUM BE PAID FOR IT. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: NOBODY HAS EVER ASKED HIM FOR A THING THAT IS NOT A JOB, AND HE DOES NOT KNOW WHAT TO DO WITH HIS HANDS.
cards.1013: AT THE LOCK-UP, IN THE ROOM OFF THE MIDDLE BAY WHERE THE MEN EAT, WHICH HAS A TABLE, FOUR CHAIRS, A STOVE AND A KETTLE, AND THE SHUTTER DOWN BEHIND THE WALL. IT IS THE LAST MORNING OF THE SEASON. THE WOMAN WHO KEEPS THE BOOK HAS THE BOOK OPEN ON THE TABLE, AND BOTH OF THE WOMEN WHO WERE ON IT ARE IN THE ROOM, AND THE SEASON’S WORK IS READ OUT AND THE WOMAN AT NINE’S NAME COMES OFF IT BECAUSE SHE ASKED FOR THAT, WITH HIM STANDING FOUR FEET AWAY OFF THE END OF THE TABLE. HE HAS ONE MOMENT IN WHICH HE COULD ASK FOR WORK IN A ROOM WITH THE REST OF THEM IN IT AND HE GETS ONE OF THEM AND HE KNOWS BOTH OF THOSE FACTS AT THE SAME TIME. WHAT STANDS AGAINST IT: ASKING THERE WOULD BE ASKING IN FRONT OF THE WOMAN WHO KEEPS THE BOOK AND OUT OF THE SAME MOUTH THAT HAS BEEN REFUSING HIM SINCE THE SUMMER. DECISION: HE DOES NOT ASK. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: THE SEASON CLOSES WITH THE ARRANGEMENT THAT HAS KEPT HIM OFF THE BOOK FOR TEN YEARS EXACTLY AS IT WAS. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: HE HAS BEEN IN THE ROOM AND HAS NOT ASKED, AND THE ONE THING HE TAKES AWAY IS THAT SHE LET HIM STAND THERE, WHICH WAS NOT ASKED OF HER EITHER.
cards.1014: AT NUMBER TWELVE, IN THE FRONT ROOM, WITH THE SASH UP FOUR INCHES AND NO CURTAIN ON THE RAIL, THE RAIL BEING BARE SINCE THE SUMMER, AND THE SIX-HOUSE PAGE ON THE TABLE WITH THE DAUGHTER’S NAME AT THE FOOT OF IT AND NOTHING UNDER THAT. THE MOTHER CAME BACK DOWN THE RIVER THAT MORNING AFTER SIX WEEKS AND HAS BEEN IN THE HOUSE ABOUT TWO HOURS AND HAS NOT BEEN TOLD ANYTHING. SHE LOOKS AT THE PAGE AND DOES NOT PICK IT UP. SHE ASKS HER DAUGHTER ONE QUESTION, AND THE QUESTION IS NOT ABOUT THE PAGE. DECISION: THE DAUGHTER TELLS HER THE TRUTH ABOUT THE COAL SHED AND ABOUT A MAN WHO CAME AND WENT AND LEFT FOUR WORDS IN CHALK ON A WALL THAT WILL BE GONE BY THE SPRING. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: HE IS STANDING IN THE ROOM FOR THE WHOLE OF IT AND SAYS NOTHING AT ALL. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: A WOMAN HAS BEEN HOME TWO HOURS AND KNOWS THAT A MAN HAS BEEN IN HER HOUSE FOR SIX WEEKS AND THAT NOT ONE PERSON ON THAT FRONTAGE COULD GIVE HER HIS NAME.

declared_ordinary_word.sense: WITH ALL FOUR SIDES EQUAL AND EVERY CORNER AT A RIGHT ANGLE, AND TRUE TO A SQUARE RATHER THAN OUT OF TRUE OR RUNNING OUT OF SQUARE. ONE SENSE ONLY. THE NOUN THE SQUARE, THE TOOL, IS NOT USED, AND THE AREA SENSE, AS IN TWO FOOT SQUARE, IS NOT USED, SO NO NUMBER AND NO UNIT APPEARS WITH IT.
declared_ordinary_word.why_this_word: THE RUN SO FAR IS ROUGHNESS, SLICK, BLUNT, BRITTLE, STIFF, COLD, DAMP, TRUE AND EVEN, AND SQUARE IS NOT ANY OF THEM. TRUE WAS A WORD ABOUT A THING AGAINST WHAT IT IS SET AGAINST AND EVEN WAS A WORD ABOUT A RUN ALONG ITS OWN LENGTH. SQUARE IS A WORD ABOUT CORNERS AND ABOUT WHETHER A THING STAYS AT RIGHT ANGLES WHEN IT IS LEFT ALONE, WHICH IS THE MEASUREMENT THIS BLOCK MAKES, BECAUSE FOUR WOMEN ASK HIM FOR FOUR THINGS AND HE KEEPS FINDING THAT A THING PUT IN AT A CORNER DOES NOT STAY SQUARE.
declared_ordinary_word.forms_not_used: SQUARELY, SQUARED, SQUARING, SQUARES AND THE PARTICLES SQUARE UP, SQUARE WITH, SQUARE AWAY, SQUARE TO AND SQUARE OFF IN THEIR OTHER SENSES ARE NOT USED AT ALL. THE MEASURE AFTER PROSE TAKES EVERY ONE OF THOSE AND GIVES A NUMBER AGAINST EACH.
declared_ordinary_word.density: AT NO MORE THAN ABOUT ONE USE IN EVERY HUNDRED WORDS, NEVER TWO IN ONE SENTENCE, NO PARTICLE FORM, COMPARATIVE AT ZERO, A DIFFERENT MATERIAL BEHIND EACH ONE, AND ONE IN EVERY CHAPTER.
declared_ordinary_word.never_in_a_closing: SQUARE APPEARS IN NONE OF THE TEN CLOSING SENTENCES, BECAUSE A MEASUREMENT WORD IN A CLOSING REPEATS ITS OWN GRAMMAR ACROSS CLOSINGS AND THE ONLY MEASURE THAT SEES THAT IS A PERSON READING THE TEN ALOUD.

one_thing_a_writer_of_1015_should_know: THE BLOCK’S PROPOSITION IS ON THE PAGE IN FOUR ASKS AND ONE REFUSAL, AND IT IS THIS: HE SPENT A WOMAN IN 1003 TO GET A PAGE HE COULD NOT USE, AND THIS BLOCK PUTS FOUR WOMEN IN FOUR ROOMS ASKING HIM FOR FOUR THINGS HE DID NOT ASK FOR, AND BY 1013 EVERY ONE OF THEM HAS ASKED HIM OUT LOUD AND HE HAS STILL NOT ASKED FOR ONE THING FROM ANYBODY WHO COULD HAVE SAID NO. THE THING A WRITER MUST CARRY IS THAT THIS IS NOT A REPEAT OF 0081. IN 0081 HE WAS REFUSED. IN 0082 HE IS ASKED, FOUR TIMES, BY PEOPLE WHO CANNOT BE ASKED BACK, AND HE ANSWERS EVERY ONE OF THEM WELL AND ASKS FOR NOTHING, AND THE CLOSE OF THE SEASON IS THE ONE MORNING ON WHICH ASKING WAS AVAILABLE TO HIM AND HE LET IT GO. NEXT BLOCK’S PROBLEM IS NOT WHETHER HE WILL ASK. IT IS WHAT HE DOES WITH THE ONE THING HE IS HANDED WHEN SOMEBODY FINALLY ASKS HIM, WHICH NONE OF THESE TEN CHAPTERS DOES.
